value.rationale: Expected reachable functional habitat versus the probability all habitat remains reachable are natural distinct reserve-design outcomes. The first cycle supporting strictly conflicting layouts under positive spatial correlation gives a meaningful sharp boundary for extending independent-risk connectivity choices: spacing always wins the mean while clustering wins perfect reliability for \(q>1/2\). The exact \(q=1/2\) crossover and five-vertex minimality supply structural, parameter-free diagnostic value within the model, without claiming field validation.
